name: DV Biomed Co., Ltd.
summary: DV Biomed Co., Ltd. is engaged in the creation, production, and international sale of high-quality, medical-grade dermatological products. The company also extends its services to include wellness and weight management programs, and operates as a distributor for professional aesthetic fillers and advanced medical beauty devices. Complementing these offerings, DV Biomed supplies health-focused food items, such as functional light and energy drinks, alongside a range of facial care and broader beauty solutions. The company was established in 2011 and operates from its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
